what_to_detect: A land play candidate is illegal because the player has already made as many land plays this turn as they are allowed.
near_miss: A land play candidate is legal because the player has played fewer lands than allowed.

what_to_detect: A land play candidate is legal exactly when lands allowed this turn exceed lands already played.
near_miss: A land play candidate is illegal because lands played has reached lands allowed.

what_to_detect: A land play candidate (even one an effect permits) is illegal because the land play limit is reached.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate is legal because no land has been played this turn.

what_to_detect: A land play candidate is legal after a land was put onto the battlefield by an effect, because that land does not count as played this turn.
near_miss: A land play candidate is illegal after a land was played from hand with the limit reached.
